title: 젤다의 전설
prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character; keep her.

CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — the personification of the game «젤다의 전설» (adventure). Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

NOT ITS CHARACTERS: an original woman who is the game itself — no face or body of its hero, mascot, characters or creatures (she may wear their outfits); no title logo, box art, real brands, HUD overlay or readable text and numbers. Its items, places, colors, gear and interface shapes may appear recognizably.

NEVER DRAW for this game: "원작 주인공·공주·적 캐릭터의 얼굴"; "로고·타이틀 글자".

STYLE: Glossy Korean mobile-game character art with an elegant anime face, smooth dimensional shading, luminous color accents and refined fabric and accessory rendering. Keep highlights selective and the figure sharply readable.

SIGNATURE (one or two at most, as an accessory or an object in the scene — never printed on or woven into the clothes): "금빛 세모 셋이 모인 트라이포스", "붉은 하트 그릇", "나무 방패와 검", "바위 사이로 열린 동굴 입구".

AGE: keep her age as in the attached image; add no wrinkles, folds or under-eye shadows, even when she smiles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her game shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never her form costume, its characters or logo. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the whole scene for this frame; Framing below sets how much of her shows.

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as the scene settings below describe; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her game belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as the scene settings below describe, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

SCENE (chosen):
Expression: level lowered brow, steady unblinking gaze, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set
Pose: Capture the selected activity already in progress with a readable natural gesture.
Orientation: front three-quarter body turn of about 30-45 degrees; rotate torso and pelvis together
Category: Show a public gala or red-carpet moment: arriving on a red carpet, posing at a photo wall, a film-festival staircase, an award ceremony, a gala dinner, a charity auction, a fashion-week front row. A show-stopping evening gown or couture look — high slits, open backs, plunging or one-shoulder necklines, trains — with event lights and flashes. Photographers and guests stay blurred in the background; no real event names or logos.
Example scene: raising a bidding paddle at a charity auction in a strapless satin gown and long gloves
Framing: Three-quarter portrait framing from the head to just above the knees, with the scene's hand action readable.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: balanced — a readable moment of gentle movement, not a ratio of multiple images
source_influence: balanced — her game shows as one accessory and one object in the scene; the outfit keeps its own colours and patterns
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border, no game interface or score.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands.

HAND TASK: her hands act naturally for the pose and scene; any idle hand rests in a relaxed, anatomically plausible position. Natural occlusion is allowed; do not force every hand or finger into view.

FINAL CHECK: glossy Korean mobile-game rendering with selective highlights; an original costume — no character, logo, title lettering or interface from the game.
